futureReadPolicy.walReadMetadataCaveat: SQLite mode=ro prevents writes to the database but an ordinary WAL reader may update SHM read-lock metadata. Do not claim zero metadata mutation; never ignore WAL using immutable=1 or copy the main DB alone as a fresh snapshot.

Requires exactly one new UUID DB birth at/after that actual launch and existing exact WAL/SHM.
interface.beforeInput: observe_zero_before_input(latest original ready observation). Stored seed240 fails; actual stored0 baseline includes actual current full-row metadata. Any failure stops before native input.
interface.afterInput: observe_after_genuine_input(fresh observation, completed_input) after original2s debounce. completed_input fields exact selector,total1/passed1/failed0/skipped0,nonce/webIdentity/index1..3,inputEndedAtUnixSeconds,beforeNativeKvoEventCount,programmaticScroll=false. This normalized evidence must be bound by wrapper to actual request/test result/raw KVO.
interface.outputs: Returns bounded dictionaries only. Caller writes outputs and partial observer.records within its own already accounted RUN_ROOT. Helper never writes files, launches a process or releases source.
interface.timer: Maximum8 SQL attempts and12s combined active SQL observation time. Original2s debounce and any wrapper retry waits stay inside existing parent180s/observer90s; no new outside deadline or automatic retry.
interface.release: Source r1 has no DB hook and releases early; a separate new reviewed wrapper must perform stored0 check before the physical test and debounce/readback before cleanup. Requires both separate physical and DB Root grants.

actualMetadataBaseline: Use other-fields digest from actually observed stored0, not from seed JSON. Legitimate startup metadata may differ from seeds. Require unchanged non-position values only between actual0 baseline and actual after-input snapshot; changes retain partial/negative evidence.
